validity.researcher_notes: This is genuinely UNRESOLVED, not an under-searched gap -- documenting the dead end in full. Two PNGRB documents, both independently downloaded and verified live (url_verifier FAILs on both -- large-PDF false negative, confirmed locally via pdftotext -layout): (1) PNGRB Public Notice PN08012024 (08 Jan 2024, https://www.pngrb.gov.in/pdf/public-notice/PN08012024.pdf) states PNGRB's original authorization of Andhra Pradesh Gas Distribution Corporation Ltd for the Kakinada-Srikakulam pipeline (granted 16.07.2014) was CANCELLED by PNGRB on 01.12.2023, and the Board then opened a fresh suo-motu proposal for the same Kakinada-Pithapuram-Anakapalle-Vizianagaram-Srikakulam corridor (20 MMSCMD) under Regulation 4(2)/6 -- i.e. this GEM row is the re-proposed successor to a cancelled authorization, not a duplicate of anything active. (2) A related but DISTINCT competitive bid, BID/NGPL/22/2024/03/MSPL (https://www.pngrb.gov.in/pdf/ngp/bid/bid22/SB-MSPL-20241212.pdf, Dec 2024), tenders a 'Mallavaram-Srikakulam Natural Gas Pipeline' spanning about 290 km / 10 MMSCMD -- a different origin point (Mallavaram, not Kakinada) and different length/capacity than the 2024 suo-motu notice, so this is NOT simply the same project renamed; flagging the relationship for a human to judge rather than asserting identity. Checked the PNGRB NGPL MIS register (20260531 edition, both the parsed JSON and the crosswalk) for 'Srikakulam', 'Kakinada-Srikakulam' and 'Mallavaram-Srikakulam' -- the only Srikakulam-adjacent authorization on the current register is 'Srikakulam-Angul' (entity GAIL, authorised 23.07.2019, a different route terminating AT Srikakulam from the north/east, not originating there) and 'Mallavaram-Bhopal-Bhilwara-Vijaipur' (entity GITL, a wholly different corridor). Neither a Kakinada-Srikakulam nor a Mallavaram-Srikakulam authorization exists in the current register despite the Dec-2024 bid's technical-bid-opening date (16.04.2025) having passed by the May-2026 edition -- either the bid is still under evaluation/challenge, or was not awarded, or the register lags. Could not determine which.
